purpose: 2026-10-10 DFT-informed campaign, S2-09, S2-10. Generated by analysis_2026-10-10_campaign/make_campaign_configs.py from campaign_matrix.json (entries verbatim, matrix order). Design: analysis_2026-10-10_campaign/CAMPAIGN_DESIGN.md.
global_rules: Sequential only: python scripts/run_campaign.py <plan> (C10 plans refuse --workers != 1). Every launch counts, failed or not. Hard cap 200: config/solver.yaml max_launches 260 (= 60 used before C10 + 200) and a C10 label counter (c10_* run IDs in RUN_INDEX <= 200) in run_campaign.py.

run_campaign.py (C10 plans) never re-launches an entry whose label already has a RUN_INDEX row, from this or any other C10 plan (MIN10 vs stage plans): a successful earlier launch is reused, a failed one is reported; --retry ID spends a new (reserve) launch on purpose.
Model file for every entry: $env:IWO_MODEL_FILE = "config/iwo_material_model_v3.yaml" (V3 + the overrides = the same solver statements as V2 + the overrides, check_v3_equivalence.py).
After any code change: python analysis_2026-10-10_campaign/regress_all_decks.py must print "unexpected differences 0" before the next launch.

run_campaign.py records a failed launch and CONTINUES; it does not apply any stop rule below. The main session reads results/campaigns/<plan>.json and analysis_2026-10-10_campaign/post_run_checks.py output after each plan and decides.
stop_rules: EXPLORATORY (A45 (d) / PA-5): FNORD as a conditional single-barrier diagnostic, S2-09 c10_s2_09_2p0 (1800 s) then S2-10 c10_s2_10_13p2 (3600 s); worst-case F.AE 2.171e-6, F.BE 8.628e7 V/cm (CALCULATED, field-transferred); HfO2 y-mesh 0.25 nm. Not a worst case or upper bound; mesh robustness ASSUMED; changes no H-C verdict.

First-launch checks (A45 (d) (c); manual_checks.md checks 3 and 4): FN plot of ifnvg.dat with slope -F.BE; I_G with the QTNLSC sign at -3 V; J.TUN in the log; current booked to the gate only (NEARFLG not set); KCL.
S2-12-TSP24 (E3) is not in this plan: it needs S2-12 ACTIVE and resolved, and S2-12 (run_0085) is invalid (timeout).
Every launch counts; a failed, out-of-memory or timed-out launch is recorded UNRESOLVED and kept; no repeat, no factor or tolerance change, no repair (PA-19 v3: D/E are not repaired or repeated).

Outputs are not sealed (not state-only); read only for the registered read-out and the manual checks (manual_checks.md); no worst-set floor-window reading (magnitude, flatness or dI_D) from QTNLSC or FNORD before the registered convergence conditions (A45 (d) (a)); no H-C verdict; no transfer to other films or oxide sets.
stop_rules_enforced_by: main session (manual); run_campaign.py enforces the launch budget and refuses runnable=false plans
register_amendment: A47 (2026-10-15; A45 (c) PA-4 and A45 (d) PA-5 entries, read-out script and order; no Codex review, D-63): invoke only after A47 and its decision row are logged, with the go for THIS launch (Claude under D-59), immediately after prelaunch_gate_c10_de.py has exited 0 naming this plan
